nodes.label: App icon (favicon) — icon.png in src/app, auto-served by Next.js App Router as the site favicon. Artwork: bold italic/slanted dark-charcoal 'R' lettermark (for "Realiza") centered on a bright lime/yellow-green square background. Minimal flat brand mark, no wordmark or other elements.

Apple touch icon — apple-icon.png in src/app, auto-served by Next.js App Router as the apple-touch-icon for iOS home-screen saves. Identical artwork to icon.png: bold slanted dark-charcoal 'R' on a lime-green square, at a smaller canvas with tighter crop around the letter.
Realiza brand mark — slanted dark 'R' lettermark on lime-green square; the platform's visual identity condensed to a single glyph, reused across browser tab icon and iOS touch icon.

hyperedges.label: Next.js App Router icon convention — both files live in src/app and are auto-wired as the app's favicon/apple-touch-icon via file-name convention, together forming the platform's icon set.
